metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1982 · The Thing
metas.description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1988 · Mississippi Burning
metas.description: Two FBI agents with wildly different styles arrive in Mississippi to investigate the disappearance of three civil rights activists.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1986 · Blue Velvet
metas.description: The discovery of a severed human ear found in a field leads a young man on an investigation related to a beautiful, mysterious nightclub singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1986 · The Name of the Rose
metas.description: An intellectually nonconformist friar investigates a series of mysterious deaths in an isolated abbey.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1988 · The Vanishing
metas.description: Rex and Saskia, a young couple in love, are on vacation. They stop at a busy service station and Saskia is abducted. After three years and no sign of Saskia, Rex begins receiving letters from the abductor.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1989 · The Abyss
metas.description: A civilian diving team is enlisted to search for a lost nuclear submarine and faces danger while encountering an alien aquatic species.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1980 · The Long Good Friday
metas.description: An up-and-coming gangster is tested by the insurgence of an unknown, very powerful threat.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1981 · Blow Out
metas.description: A movie sound recordist accidentally records the evidence that proves that a car accident was actually murder and consequently finds himself in danger.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1985 · Clue
metas.description: Six guests are anonymously invited to a strange mansion for dinner, but after their host is killed, they must cooperate with the staff to identify the murderer as the bodies pile up.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1987 · Angel Heart
metas.description: In 1955 New Orleans, small-time private investigator Harry Angel is hired by a man who calls himself Louis Cypher to track down a singer named Johnny Favorite, but the investigation takes an unexpected and somber turn.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1986 · Manhunter
metas.description: Former FBI profiler Will Graham returns to service to pursue a deranged serial killer dubbed "the Tooth Fairy" by the media.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1986 · The Hitcher
metas.description: A young man who escapes the clutches of a murderous hitchhiker is subsequently stalked by the hitcher and framed for his crimes.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1980 · The Changeling
metas.description: After experiencing tragic personal losses, a music professor rents a Seattle mansion, haunted by a slain boy.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1980 · Dressed to Kill
metas.description: A mysterious blonde woman kills one of the patients of a psychiatrist and then goes after the high-class hooker who witnessed the murder.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1982 · Tenebrae
metas.description: An American novelist visiting Rome to promote his latest book is stalked and harassed by an obsessed fan who is committing a string of murders that appear to be tributes to his work.
